purpose: Apply the shared suite community-health shell to Ask the Model while keeping application/provider/model boundaries explicit.
invariants: AtM is an interface, not a scientific model.
External providers and AI model files remain separate dependencies/artifacts.
Do not present AI-generated content as a canonical EWD/CBD/RMD result without repository-grounded provenance or actual model execution.
Do not bump the application version as part of an unrelated change.
Release publication must remain tied to the exact versioned release notes and reviewed commit.
